content.title: Approaches, Methods and Tools for Integrated Development

content.intro: M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation

content.text:
The previous section explored the global landscape of partnerships and financing for sustainable energy and SDG integration, and described emerging strategies to leverage and scale-up financing.

This chapter describes approaches and methods currently being applied - within the UN system and beyond - to uncover system interconnections, policy coherence and strengthen integration across the SDGs.
Approaches are intended to guide the overarching strategy, methods define the step-by-step procedures.
Tools provide the means to execute those procedures effectively within the chosen approach and method.

After completing this section, you will be clear on why a focus on system interconnections is key for achieving sustainable development, and what coherent policymaking entails. You will also become aware of specific approaches, methods and tools that can be employed to foster SDGs interlinkages in practice.
Does the concept of coherent policymaking make sense to you?
Why would policymaking not be coherent in the first place?
Why are efforts required to foster SDG interlinkages?
